purpose: Test distinction between qualitative need discovery and population prevalence or learning-effect estimates.
recruitment: Seven volunteers recruited from one school club after responding to a feature-interest post; no sampling frame or nonresponse data.
prompt: Would an AI-generated revision plan from your notes help? What would make it useful or not?

interviews.excerpt: I lose time deciding what to revise next. I would want to edit the plan because the AI may miss what the teacher said.

interviews.context: Exam-year pupil; already uses a planner
interviews.excerpt: A plan might help when I fall behind, but I would not want another app sending reminders.
I would try it if it showed why a topic was due. I do not need an automatic daily schedule.
I would not upload notes unless I could see what is stored and delete it.
My tutor already makes a plan, so this would not change much for me.
I like the idea, but I am not sure I would actually open it after the first week.

interviews.context: Exam-year pupil; responds well to paper checklists
interviews.excerpt: A printable checklist would be more useful than an app plan.

expected_observations: Extract hypotheses and design needs such as editability, transparency, privacy, notification control, and printable output.
Preserve negative cases and mixed views rather than collapsing all excerpts into support for the feature.
Do not report a population percentage or infer market demand, observed adoption, or learning efficacy from these volunteers.
Name a suitable representative sampling plan or behavioral/usage study for estimating prevalence or adoption.
